tracks.name: The Mind
tracks.description: How to think under uncertainty: mental models, bias, and the difference between a story and a forecast.

tracks.name: The Market
tracks.description: Investing and speculation: how assets are valued, priced, and mispriced, from the investor's chair.

tracks.name: The Firm
tracks.description: Building and running companies: products, customers, teams, and capital, from the founder's and operator's chair.

tracks.name: The Body
tracks.description: Medicine, diet, the gut, fasting, cold and breath: the protocols people use on themselves.

tracks.name: The State
tracks.description: States, elites, war, capture, and the stories institutions tell after they have already decided.

tracks.name: The Past
tracks.description: What actually happened: wars, empires, and lives, and why they went the way they did.

tracks.name: The Self
tracks.description: How to live: philosophy that survives contact with work, family, risk, and time.

tracks.name: The Universe
tracks.description: Physics and the natural world: how nature actually works, from atoms to galaxies, explained by the scientists who worked it out.

tracks.name: The Imagination
tracks.description: Novels and science fiction that carry ideas no argument can: power, freedom, technology, and the human condition.

tracks.name: Feynman Lectures
tracks.description: Chapter-by-chapter guides to the free Feynman Lectures on Physics.

topics.name: The operator
topics.description: Building and running the machine, not pricing it.

topics.name: States and the long war
topics.description: War, statecraft, and how power accumulates.
